conclusion: From the SAVED offline evidence alone, nothing about GPC/TPC/SM/ROP topology can be decoded: the saved MMIO snapshot contains no topology register (gpc_nr/tpc_nr/TPC_UNIT all absent), the saved nvidia-smi log lacks multiProcessorCount, and the public TU106-applicable header set (tu102, 37 headers) has no dev_top.h/dev_gr.h and no dev_fuse.h field at fuse+0x650 or 0xc1c. The only PROVED raw facts are fuse base+0x650 = 0x4001f and base+0xc1c = 0x38 (verified against saved fuse2.json). The archived claims '3 GPC, 17 TPC, 34 SM' are query/register claims from BAO_CAO prose whose source addresses were never captured in the saved snapshot; they are consistent with each other and with the raw fuse popcounts, but consistency is not a decode. Every topology count remains UNKNOWN with the missing capture listed above.
